Application Data.NAME: GlassWorks Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: GlassWorks Inc. specializes in providing comprehensive glass and window services, including installation, repair, and replacement for residential and commercial clients. Our operations focus on ensuring high-quality service using certified domestic manufacturers for all glass products, adhering to ASTM International standards. We prioritize safety and quality, implementing strict protocols during installations to minimize property damage and ensure compliance with industry regulations. Our team is trained to handle the transportation of large glass panels within a defined geographic radius of 100 miles, ensuring secure loading and transit to reduce the risk of accidents. We also offer on-site consultations for design and specification services directly related to our installations, promoting customer satisfaction and safety throughout the process.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, during a routine window installation at a commercial property, a technician accidentally dropped a glass pane, causing it to shatter and resulting in $4,500 in damage to the client’s hardwood flooring. The claim was reported on March 16, 2023, and is currently in the process of settlement. No injuries occurred, and safety protocols were followed during the installation.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL 764 Certified, 2-Hour Fire Rating, Secured Locking Mechanism
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras, perimeter fencing, 24/7 monitored alarm system, and on-site watchperson during after-hours operations.
